proposition: The Iʿtiqādāt and the Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I are companion pieces addressed to Shāhrukh, both connected with the accusations of heresy against Ibn Turka at Herat and both with Majlis 10196 copy dates of Herat, 19 Jumādā I and 8 Rajab 829/1426; the Iʿtiqādāt is a creed presenting him as a Sunni-Ashʿarī, the Nafsat I an apology, and both were written to the ruler judging him.

mediation.note: written to the ruler judging him; what these show is what he told Shāhrukh, not necessarily what he held
